༄༅/ /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi bstod pa rol mo'i sprin phung bzhugs/oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang yul 'khor dang bcas pa la bas

tei:div.tei:p: /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi bstod pa rol mo'i sprin phung bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang yul 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngags pa rol mo'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ /'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal la/ /dpal ldan bkra shis nyin mor byed gang skye dgu kun gyis bstod gyur pa/ /'jig rten mes dang mchod sbyin brgya pa nyi zla'i snang ba 'phrog byed dang*/ /lha chen mgrin sngon pad dkar mig yangs sum rtsen mgyogs pa'i shugs 'chang sogs/ /lha mchog rnams kyi gtsug gis gus mchod thub dbang nyi ma'i gnyen de rgyal/ /dang ba'i mkha' la ri bong 'dzin gzugs mtshan mo'i mig gi bdud rtsi gang*/ /kun mkhyen mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin ni khyod skur mtshungs pa'i cha shas can/ /'gro blo'i ma rig mun pa sel la sngon med bsil zer dbang po gang*/ /rgya mtsho'i lha mo snyan dngags mkhan des de ring bdag blo'i kun da skyongs/ /ma lus rab mchog thar pa 'dod la mthar thug zhi bar 'gro ba'i skas/ /lha mi'i bde 'bras yon tan gnyer la dge legs 'dod ster rol pa can/ /gang la ci 'dod re ba skong la nor bu bum mchog dpag bsam shing*/ /ngo mtshar rten gsum gtsug lag khang la dad brgya'i gtsug gi pad+mos mchod/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal mchog dang grub mchog gis/ /bsod nams 'dun slad thar pa'i them skas su/ /bde gshegs gzhal med khang mdzes bzhengs pa la/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i me tog 'thor ro kye/ /lhun po'i lho phyogs dpal ldan gangs ri'i yul/ /'phags pa'i rgyal pos mgon du mdzad pa gang*/ /bstan pa dar la rten gsum grangs mang bas/ /'dzam gling yul las khyad par 'phags pa lags/ mi rnams rab mchog 'phags pa'i rgyud du skyes pa gang*/ /yul rnams che ba thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams der/ /chos rnams rgyas pa theg pa mchog rnams dar ba'i gnas/ /rgyal rnams bsngags pa glang ru lung bstan lags so kye/

/de ltar ngo mtshar rmad byung las/ /byang phyogs sbas yul rin chen gling*/ /ri mtho sa gtsang nyams dga' ba/ /bkra shis dge mtshan phun sum tshogs/ /sngon rabs sngon rabs rnams su yang dang yang*/ /grub mchog grub mchog rnams kyis byin brlabs pas/ /phyi rabs phyi rabs rnams su'ang bkra shis pa/ /ngo mtshar ngo mtshar 'phags rnams 'byung ba lags/ /phyogs rnams mdangs bzang gangs ri'i phreng bas btud gyur la/ /ri phran rin chen ra bas kun nas bskor ba'i dbus/ /sa rnams 'dab brgyad pad+ma kha phye lta bu la/ /gnam yang rtsibs stong mu khyud 'dzin 'dras rnam par mdzes/ /shar ri rin chen khang brtsegs lta bu la/ /lho ri sman shing 'bru rnams spungs 'dra zhing*//nub ri 'dod 'byung nor bu lta bu la/ /byang ri sna tshogs nor lha'i pad phung bzhin/ /lhung lhung snyan sgrogs bdud rtsi'i chu bo yang*/ /yang yang dbang gi phyogs nas bskor zhing 'babs/ /khrung khrung ngang pa mang po rtse dga'i gnas/ /chil chil rlabs kyis bskyod 'di e ma mtshar/ /ri rtse sman ljongs nags kyi mthongs rnams nyams dga' la/ /sman shing me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams dwangs spro zhing*/ /bya dang ri dwags rtsed 'jo bgyid rnams mdzes pas gang*/ /mtho ris grong gi dpal rnams phyogs 'dir spungs sam snyam/ /phyogs bzhi'i phyogs mtshams mdzes pa'i yul rnams dang*/ /ri dbang ri phran mang po'i tshogs 'di ni/ /lha yul lha rnams kun nas mdzes pa'am/ /dad ldan dad pas phyogs 'dir mchod pa bzhin/ /nyin bzhin dmar ba'i dus mtshams chu 'dzin ma lags shing*/ /tsan+dan bsil ba'i ma la ya ri min na yang*//mdzes dgur byed la sngon gyi grub pas brten pa'i slad//drang srong mchog rnams kun nas dgyes pa'i bsti gnas lags/ /mngon sum dbang po'i yul la shar ba'i yul/ /yul gzhan yon tan dam pa mchis pa kun/ /kun nas bsdus te phyogs 'dir bkod bzhin mdzes/

/mdzes pa 'di 'dra 'gro la gsal bar mngon/ /bzhad rnams brten pa'i rdzing bu dang mtshungs gdangs snyan skye bo'i rtsed 'jo 'phel/ /bung bas chab kyi pad+mo dang mtshungs skye dgu 'du bas mdzes gyur la/ /dpag med yon tan mtsho chen dang mtshungs bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /gdengs can rol pa'i gan mdzod dang mtshungs mtha' yas 'dod rgu 'byung ba lags//de 'dra'i yul 'di 'phags pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /rgyal ba'i rten gsum pho brang mdzes pas na/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu shin tu mdzes pa'i zhing*/ /pad+mo can la mngon par rgyal 'dod bzhin/ /sa 'dzin phyogs kyi ri bo rnams kyang phyogs 'dir rtse mo dud pas gang*/ /dkar gsal gangs ri'i thod bcings dang ldan mgur chu rol ba'i sprin gyis 'khyud/ /ngos rnams mthon mthing dbyar rtswa'i gos gyon sman shing me tog rgyan phreng can/ /chu gtsang sman spos dri zhim ngad kyis gzhal med khang 'dir mchod pa bzhin/ /chu 'dzin rol pa'i na chung rnams kyang phyogs 'dir g.yo bas gar byed pa/ /gser zhun 'bar ba'i rked chings dang ldan glog phreng 'gyu ba'i 'od zer can/ /zab cing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs 'brug sgra bstod dbyangs me tog char 'babs pa/ /ngo mtshar rten gsum gzhal med mchod la nam mkha'i bdag pos bkod pa bzhin/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ /phyogs 'dir dad pa'i shugs kyis rab bskyod te/ /'od stong sgron me'i snang bas mchod pa'i phyir/ /lha lam gshegs pa 'di yis mdzes so kye/ /mtshan mo'i lha mo 'jig rten mig de yang*/ /skar ma'i na chung mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /phyogs 'dir zhi ba'i zhal bzang rab bskyod de/ /bsil ba'i 'od zer dra ba 'gyed la ltos/ /da ni sems gtsang dag pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /ngo mtshar zhing la dad pa'i rlabs bskyed de/ /phyi ma'i chus srid bsod nams 'dun slad du/ /'phags pa'i yul 'dir dga' bas brten par rigs/

/ de 'dra'i gnas 'di sbas yul rin chen gling*/ /'od dpag med kyi pho brang brgyan pa ni/ /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar nyer bkra ba/ /bde ba can gyi zhing 'dir 'phos pa bzhin/ /phyi rim bkod pa ngo mtshar rmad byung bsam gtan dang ba'i gzhal yas bzhin/ /sgyu 'phrul mkhan gyi mig 'phrul dang 'dra 'di zhes gcig tu ma nges la/ /pha rol gnon pa'i stobs chen khro bos bgegs rnams 'joms pa lta bu ste/ /yon tan mtha' yas gang gā'i bye snyed sa 'og rin chen snying po lags/ /nang rnams rnam bkra lha yi dkyil 'khor kun nas mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang*/ /bla re 'phan lding rin chen rnams bskyod sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin 'phro ba/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i khyad par 'di ni rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rmad byung ste/ /mthong thos dran reg 'khor ba phyir bsnyil thar pa'i sa bon 'debs pa mtshar/ /de lta'i gzhal med dbus na bcom ldan 'das/ /nye ba'i 'khor nang 'od stong 'gyed pa ni/ /rgyu skar dbus na ri bong 'dzin gzugs sam/ /zhi ba'i 'khor nang tshangs pa mdzes pa bzhin/ /'dzum mdzes gser gyi pad+mo dngar bas 'gro ba'i mig gi bdud rtsi gang*/ /'dzum bcas zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor brnyes pas rin chen pad+ma'i steng bzhugs te/ /'dzum pa'i zhal gyi 'od zer gsal bas 'jig rten gsum po khyab mdzad cing*/ /'dzum mdzad dgyes pa'i dpal gyi mgul nas da lta gsung mchog 'byon pa snyam/ /de 'dra'i mgon po'i bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang nor bu'i 'od rnams kyi/ /zer gyis mun pa sel ba la/ /mtshungs na ci snyems 'od dpag med/ /nor bu sgron glog snang bas ma gsal ba'i/ /'gro kun mi shes mi rig mun pa'i smag /lta ba'i 'thib po rmad byung sel mdzad pas//'od dpag med ces mngon brjod ma 'khrul kye/ /khyod sku mtshan dpe'i rgyan mchog gis/ /spras par gyur bzhin rgyan gzhan gyis/ /lha yi gos dang lhan cig tu/

/ci slad nye bar mdzes pa gang*/ /gya gyur gsal ba lha mi'i 'gro dag kyang*/ /rin chen rgyan dang gos kyis mdzes byed na/ /mgon po gzhan don 'phags pa'i rgyal po la/ /yid 'ong rgyan phreng 'byor ba cis mi mdzes/ / mgon po gser gyi ri ngogs las/ /nyin byed 'od zer stong 'phro ba/ /go skabs gzhan du ma mthong bas/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ /'od stong 'gyed pas gling bzhi'i mun sel na/ /thugs rje'i ngang can 'gro la phan bde'i 'od/ /dpag med 'gyed pa 'di las mtshar ci mchis/ /khyad par mchog las phul gyur pa'i/ /yon tan de 'dra gang na zhig /sa skyong srid pa gsum gyi mthar/ /yongs su bzung 'di gang zhig kye/ /dpag med dus nas 'gro ba'i don phyir te/ /gang rnams 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan med pas/ /de yi 'od dang mtshungs pa 'dra med phyir/ /thugs rje 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge mchog dang rma bya'i steng na bcom ldan rgyal po'i cha byad can/ /dbu rgyan mgur chu do shal dpung rgyan sna tshogs na bza' lhab lhub mdzes/ / mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor dpal du 'bar bas skye dgu'i mig gi bdud rtsi gang*/ /dpag med yon tan rgya mtsho brnyes la kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gis mchod/ /gang zhig mtshan ma'i yul las 'das kyang mtshan stong 'bar ba'i skur ston cing*/ /mtshan bcas spros pa'i mtha' las 'das kyang mtshan 'dzin skye bo 'dul ba'i slad/ /mtshan med zhi ba'i chos rab ston kyang mtshan ma kun las nges grol ba/ /mtshan mar mi dmigs mkha' bzhin dag kyang mtshan gyis srid mtsho skyob la 'dud//'di ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bla mar byon/ /de yi gzugs brnyan 'gro blo yi/ /dag pa'i rdzing bur shar ba mtshar/ /thugs rje'i zhal bzang 'gro la g.yo ba dang*/ /mnyam du 'gro ba'i dad brgya der g.yo bas/ / skye dgu'i nyon mongs rtsad nas bton pa bzhin/

/mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal la/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs 'khor gyi dbus na mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba la/ /sems dpa' gzugs mdzes blta na sdug dang pad+mo'i 'dzin sogs gus bcas te/ /pha rol gnon pa'i stobs chen khro bo 'jigs gzugs rngams pa'i sprin 'phro bas/ /yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal la/ /'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan rgyan bkod 'od dpag med zhing bkod pa dang*/ /mi 'khrugs zhing gi yon tan rnams bkod rang byon sprul pa'i zhing bkod dang*/ /bskal bzang 'dren pa'i zhing khams rnam bkod 'phags pa sdong po bkod de dang*/ /rgyal ba'i yum gsum rnam par bkod dang chos rje'i zhing khams bkod la 'dud/ /gang gis byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /grangs med gsum gyi mthar son te/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /yongs su bskor bar mdzad la 'dud/ /gang gis thog mar 'gro 'di gzigs nas byang chub thugs ni bskyed nas su/ / grangs med bskal par brtson pa'i go bgos tshogs gnyis bsags pa mthar phyin nas/ /rdo rje gdan du mngon par byang chub wā ra ṇā sīr gshegs mdzad de/ /lnga sde bzang po brgyad khri'i lhar bcas chos kyi bdud rtsis tshims la 'dud/ /thub dbang zhi ba'i chos kyi char 'bebs la/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje 'dzin pas gus btud de/ /tshangs dang brgya byin gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul/ /ngo mtshar mchog tu 'phags la phyag 'tshal la/ /bde ba can na 'od dpag med de ri bo ta lar spyan ras gzigs/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir pad+ma rgyal po 'gro la tha dad snang gyur kyang*/ /sku gsum mdzad pa'i ngo bor gcig ste dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /gangs can 'gro la lhag par brtse ba'i thugs rje mnga' ba de la 'dud/ /'dzam bu'i gling na mkhas pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /rgyal ba kun dang mkhyen rab dgongs pa mnyam/ /skye shi med pa rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa/

/bi ma mi tra dad brgya'i gtsug gis mchod/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa'i rgyud mkhyen spyan dang mngon shes dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /las dang nyon mongs bag la nyal kun bcom nas dngos grub mchog brnyes shing*/ /gdos bcas phung po rnam par dag nas mkha' la 'ja' bzhin rab yal ba/ /ting 'dzin bzang po grub pa mchog brnyes de la gus pa'i gtsug gi mchod/ /shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab par mkhyen rab nyi ma'i snying po brnyes/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi'i tshul gyis 'gro la chos tshul snang mdzad de/ /zhu chen sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug mkhas pa bai ro tsa na gang*/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub brnyes nas mkha' la 'ja' bzhin yal la 'dud/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs pas/ /rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro ba 'dul/ /gangs can dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i//chos rgyal mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba'i yum gyur pha rol phyin pa'i ngang*//rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rten 'brel so so las/ /gnod pa zhi mdzad phan bde'i phrin las can/ /phra men mchod rten 'phags la phyag 'tshal la/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kyi mthar khyab ma lus yongs su bsrung ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod gtsug lag khang rnams skyong ba'i phyir//'bar ba'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gang la gang 'dul der ston pa/ /sngags bdag gza' dang dam can rgya mtshor bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /de ltar rten gsum ngo mtshar rmad byung la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal dang bas skyabs su mchi/ /sna tshogs mchod 'bul ma lus sdig kun bshags/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis gzigs par mdzad du gsol/ /da lta mngon bzhugs 'gro la brtse sprin rol pa can/ /phra men mchod rten 'phags la phyag 'tshal la/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kyi mthar khyab ma lus yongs su bsrung ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod gtsug lag khang rnams skyong ba'i phyir/

/'bar ba'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gang la gang 'dul der ston pa/ /sngags bdag gza' dang dam can rgya mtshor bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /de ltar rten gsum ngo mtshar rmad byung la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal dang bas skyabs su mchi/ /sna tshogs mchod 'bul ma lus sdig kun bshags/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis gzigs par mdzad du gsol/ /da lta mngon bzhugs 'gro la brtse sprin rol pa can/ /thugs rje'i 'brug stong sa gsum skye bo'i mkhar khyab pa//phan bde'i char gyis kun nas phan par mdzad de rnams/ /snyigs dus thugs rjes sdug bsngal kun las bskyab tu gsol/ /kye ma ded dpon 'gro ba'i yab/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /skye dgu thugs rje'i gru chen gyis/ /yongs su sgrol bar mdzad du gsol/ /mgon po bcom ldan khyod nyid bzhugs bzhin du/ /srid pa'i mun nag da dung ci slad 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i 'od gcig bkye bas 'khor ba yi/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag rnams sangs par mdzod/ /mkhyen rab mchog gi 'od zer dang ldan mi shes rab rib sel ba gang*/ /ma lus skye dgu'i don bsgrub mdzad la yid bzhin nor 'dra'i mthu mnga' ba/ /dpag med tshe ldan rgyal ba'i dbang pos 'gro kun srid mtshor sgrol mdzod la/ /'od dpag med kyi gnas rab mchog der yongs su drang bar mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i pho brang la/ / bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i me tog char phab pas/ /'gro kun zhi ba byang chub lam zhugs te/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /tshul 'di snyan dngags pad rdzing bzang po na/ /mngon brjod 'dab stong sdeb sbyor ze'u can/ /don zab sbrang rtsi'i snying po dang ldan pa/ /dri med 'od zer gnyen des bkod pa yin/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /tshangs dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal rnam thos bu'i/ /mtshan dpe zil gyis gnon pa'i ye shes lus/

/yon tan rgya mtshos brgyan pa thob par shog /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang yul 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngags pa rol mo'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos bkod pa dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi bstod pa rol mo'i sprin phung*/ -PAGE 24--PAGE 23--20-
